topic: What is an AI agent, and how is it different from generative AI?

slides.headline: Chatbots *answer*. AI agents get things done.

slides.heading: What an *AI agent* is
body: A program given a goal it works toward.
It plans, acts and checks its own progress.

slides.heading: How it works, in a *loop*
body: Look at the goal and the current state.
Choose a step, use a tool, check the result.

slides.heading: Generative AI *makes* things
body: You give it a prompt, it gives you output.
Text, images or code, one request at a time.

slides.heading: Agents keep *going*
body: Given a goal, they break it into steps.
They use tools and adjust when things fail.

slides.heading: The simple *test*
body: One reply and done? Generative AI.
Plans, uses tools, loops? An agent.

slides.headline: Same technology family. Different jobs.
slides.cta: Which task would you give an agent first?
